hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(git commit|git push)'; then BASE=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python "$BASE/scripts/validate-structure.py" && python "$BASE/scripts/validate-citations.py" && python "$BASE/scripts/validate-metadata.py"; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'paper/sections/|paper/outline\.md'; then BASE=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python "$BASE/scripts/validate-word-count.py" 2>/dev/null || true; python "$BASE/scripts/validate-prose.py" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'paper/metadata\.yaml'; then BASE=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python "$BASE/scripts/validate-metadata.py" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
